title: mail: user_flags store (\Seen, \Flagged per article)
description:
Implement UserFlagsStore in crates/mail/src/state/flags.rs backed by the user_flags SQLite table (user_id, article_cid BLOB, seen INTEGER, flagged INTEGER). Methods: set_flags(user_id, cid, seen, flagged), get_flags(user_id, cid) → Option<Flags>, list_flagged_cids(user_id, group_name). Use parameterized queries throughout.

Why: \Seen tracking is the minimum required to let clients mark messages read; \Flagged adds star/flag functionality.

Acceptance: set_flags then get_flags returns the same values; toggling seen does not affect flagged.
